_comment: Recorded live: each statement granted TO a fresh role 'probe', then SHOW ROLE probe PRIVILEGES AS COMMANDS. Identical on Neo4j 5.26.31 and 2026.08.1. Databases 'sales' and 'probedb' existed; no aliases.

cases.statement: GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASES * TO probe
stored: GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE * TO `probe`

cases.statement: GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASES sales, probedb TO probe
stored: GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE `probedb` TO `probe`
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE `sales` TO `probe`

cases.statement: GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE SALES TO probe
stored: GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE `sales` TO `probe`

cases.statement: GRANT ACCESS ON HOME DATABASE TO probe
stored: GRANT ACCESS ON HOME DATABASE TO `probe`

cases.statement: GRANT TRAVERSE ON GRAPHS sales, probedb NODES Person, Movie TO probe
stored: GRANT TRAVERSE ON GRAPH `probedb` NODE Movie TO `probe`
GRANT TRAVERSE ON GRAPH `probedb` NODE Person TO `probe`
GRANT TRAVERSE ON GRAPH `sales` NODE Movie TO `probe`
GRANT TRAVERSE ON GRAPH `sales` NODE Person TO `probe`

stored: GRANT READ {name} ON GRAPH `sales` RELATIONSHIP * TO `probe`

GRANT READ {name} ON GRAPH `sales` NODE Person TO `probe`
